QuestInfo.name: Tienk's Monster Card
QuestInfo.0: Tienk, who is at Lith Harbor, said he would give me a monster card as a 4 Year Anniversary gift...
QuestInfo.1: Tienk said he will give me a monster card as a gift if I bring him a Maple Leaf.
QuestInfo.2: I gave a Maple Leaf to Tienk and received a Monster Card as a gift.
